body.name: m_t(\lambda,\vartheta)
body.def: On the legal uniform binary-row kill-test construction, \(R_0=-1\), \(m_0(\lambda,\vartheta)=-1\), and \(m_t(\lambda,\vartheta)=R_t[(1-\lambda)+\lambda\{(1-\vartheta)+\vartheta R_{t-1}\}m_{t-1}(\lambda,\vartheta)]\) for \(t=1,\ldots,T\).
body.role: Conditional target-state spin realized by the explicit synchronizer--two-permutation response-law family.
